in_sanskrit.name: रुद्रानी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who belongs to Rudra, the god of destruction and the lord of rains. Rudra is also known as Shiva, the destroyer and the god of the universe.

in_hindi.name: रुद्रानी
in_hindi.long_meaning: Rudra ke liye apna aadmi, hai woh Rudraani. Rudra ek dharaan bhar mahadev, shiv, vishnu ke sath itihaas ke andar ek maha purush hai jiske saath prakriti ka vibhinn samuday hote hain. Rudra ek prakritik shakti ke saath ek purush hai, jiske praan jivan hai. Is prakritik shakti ka ek avatar hai, jo rudra ke liye anusaar hai. Rudraani, wo hai jo Rudra ke liye banati hai, woh Rudra ke ghar mein rehti hai.

in_tamil.name: ருத்ரானி
in_tamil.long_meaning: Rudranan, the lady who is the abode and the dwelling of Rudran, the god of rain and destruction in Tamil mythology. Rudra is a powerful god, one of the three major deities in Hinduism, and is considered as the destroyer and the lord of the universe.

in_telugu.name: రుద్రానీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: Rudrani, the beloved consort of Rudra, the god of rain and destruction in Telugu mythology. Rudra is a powerful god, one of the three major deities in Hinduism, and is considered as the destroyer and the lord of the universe.

in_marathi.name: Rudraani
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Rudra
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rudraani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Rudraani is derived from the name of the Hindu god Rudra, who represents destruction and transformation. The name Rudraani can be interpreted as 'Goddess of Rudra'. In Hindu mythology, Rudra is also known as Shiva, the god of the universe, and the destroyer of evil. Rudraani is believed to embody the power and strength of Rudra, and is often invoked for protection and renewal.
